name: Alharamain
summary: The official app of the General Presidency for the Affairs of the Grand Mosque and the Prophet’s Mosque, serving pilgrims and visitors to Mecca and Medina.
contributions: Worked on the official app that serves pilgrims and visitors at the Grand Mosque and the Prophet’s Mosque.
It brings together prayer times, live broadcasts of prayers, wayfinding inside both mosques, news, and e-services for visitors.
